title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE TEMPORARY SUSPENSION OF OPERATIONS IN CONNECTION WITH THE ASSESSMENT AND COLLECTION OF A LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCES OF LAGUNA AND BATANGAS.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE TEMPORARY SUSPENSION OF OPERATIONS IN CONNECTION WITH THE ASSESSMENT AND COLLECTION OF A LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCES OF LAGUNA AND BATANGAS.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định tạm ngừng hoạt động liên quan đến việc đánh giá và thu thuế đất tại các tỉnh Laguna và Batangas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้ระงับการปฏิบัติงานชั่วคราวที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการประเมินและการเก็บภาษีที่ดินในจังหวัดลากูนาและบาตังกัส
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengatur Penangguhan Sementara Operasi yang Berkaitan dengan Penilaian dan Pemungutan Pajak Tanah di Provinsi Laguna dan Batangas
title.ms: Akta Mengadakan Penangguhan Sementara Operasi yang Berkaitan dengan Penilaian dan Kutipan Cukai Tanah di Wilayah Laguna dan Batangas

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
All operations in connection with the assessment and collection of a land tax in the Province of
Laguna shall be suspended until civil government is established in that province.

All operation in connection with the assessment and collection of a land tax in the Province of
Batangas shall be suspended until that province is restored to the executive control of the Civil Governor.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 11, 1902.
